response.sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), ra AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM dc), ab AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, account_count - region_avg AS above_region_avg FROM ra WHERE account_count > region_avg) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, above_region_avg, account_count * 1.0 / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_above FROM ab ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_above DESC LIMIT 10
